interpretation: Natural motions divide into those of things moved by themselves and those of things not moved by themselves, as the light and the heavy (255b32-33). Reading step: the second kind is stated positively from 255b29-31 (such things have a principle of motion, not of moving or acting, but of being acted on), which the text says of the light and the heavy, its example (οἷον); the reading extends it to every natural motion that is not a self-motion. The positive form keeps the division from being an instance of excluded middle.
